card.name: Leading digit before a thousands comma
card.fires_on: The first digit or digits of a number just before the thousands comma, such as the 1 in 1,050 or the 0 in 110,200. It shows up in doses, units and measurements.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: Leading digits of numbers in the thousands in mg or unit dosing text, right before the comma.

modes.label: Converted measurements
modes.description: Leading digits of numbers in the thousands inside metric or imperial conversions, right before the comma.

card.writes: It promotes punctuation such as commas and periods and suppresses code-like comma strings, so it expects a comma after the digit.
card.plain: It fires on the digits just before the comma in a large number like 1,050 or 9,600.
